QuestInfo.name: Sky Guardian Penni
QuestInfo.0:
When you called Pan's name, you saw an image, although you couldn't make out the face.
When you called #bPenni#k's name, he... didn't seem to manifest like Pan did. 

What now?
QuestInfo.1:
Pan came up with a plan: jump off the cliff on the count of three.
Reckless, but you didn't see any other way to get to Penni. 

Besides, #byou trust Pan.#k 
One, two, three -- you closed your eyes and jumped.
QuestInfo.2:
You jumped off the cliff with Pan.
Just as the ocean came rushing up, a blue light enveloped you, and you found yourself riding on Penni's wings. He'd manifested.

On the back of the now-majestic bird, you rose back up the cliff.
